zh.text: 芝加哥大学位于美国伊利诺伊州芝加哥海德公园，是一所私立研究型大学。该校于1890年由约翰·洛克菲勒创办。学校由一所本科生院和四所研究生学部组成，涵盖生物科学、艺术人文、物理科学和社会科学等领域。此外，大学还设有商业、法律、医学等职业学院。芝加哥大学在伦敦、巴黎、北京、德里、香港及芝加哥市中心设有学术中心。

en.text: The University of Chicago is a private research university located in the Hyde Park community area of Chicago, Illinois. Founded in 1890 by John D. Rockefeller, the institution is composed of an undergraduate college and four graduate research divisions. These divisions cover biological sciences, arts and humanities, physical sciences, and social sciences. The university also operates professional schools in fields such as business, law, medicine, and public policy. Academic centers are maintained in London, Paris, Beijing, Delhi, Hong Kong, and downtown Chicago.
